desc: Appointment of M/s. MSKA & Associates LLP as the statutory auditors of the Company for a term of 5 years.
Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 with respect to the Appointment/re-appointment of Directors in the 42nd AGM of the Company.

Pursuant to Regulation 44(3) of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith the Combined Voting Results (i.e., result of remote e-voting together with that of the e-voting conducted at the meeting)  and the Scrutinizer''s Report on the Combined Voting Results in respect of the 42nd Annual General Meeting of the Popular Vehicles and Services Limited, held on 28th August, 2026.
